# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 33 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_011_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 11

**1** Jesus said: "This sky [тпе] will pass away [паране], and the one above it will pass away.

**2** The dead [нетмооут] are not alive [оноз], and the living [нетоноз] will not die.

**3** In the days when you consumed [оуом] the dead, you made it living [оноз].

**4** When you come to dwell [шооп] in the light, what will you do?

**5** On the day when you were one [оуа], you became two [снау]. But when you become two, what will you do?"

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *тпе*: sky, heaven; "this sky" implies a cosmological hierarchy
- *паране*: to pass away, perish; eschatological language
- *нетмооут / нетоноз*: the dead / the living — present-tense participial forms
- *оуом*: to eat, consume — making the dead living by consuming/internalizing it
- *оуа / снау*: one / two — the move from primordial unity to duality, and the question of what comes next
- The saying moves through cosmology, anthropology, ethics, and eschatology
- The "two" may refer to the body/soul split, male/female split, or the divided self
